# T04 sentence bank and speech authoring

**P0-T04 authoring is complete.** This document is generated from canonical JSON; the owner HTML owns task status. Native integration is separate.

3275 dependency-complete candidates cover 6126 of 6126 form/sense/variant targets. 0 remain in the full [gap ledger](coverage.json). All 304 original examples retain their identities, Japanese, translations and context, with reviewed annotations.

5616 speech targets include 466 dictionary forms. All 155 bound contexts are authored: 114 vocabulary entries / 120 forms and 35 Kanji lexical occurrences. The earlier 53-entry count missed the second wave-dash character and readings without a marker.

Source orthographic readings inherit the pinned T02 primary review. Newly authored bound contexts, particle edits and the listed complete candidates received B-U-51 primary self-review. No native voice/listening, independent-human, remaining-locales or release acceptance follows.
